heard: No human-made object had ever crossed the asteroid belt or reached Jupiter. In 1972, NASA's Pioneer 10 became the first nuclear-powered probe to attempt the journey. It survived intense radiation that triggered false commands while passing within 82,000 miles of Jupiter. On its hull, a gold anodized plaque showed two human figures and a map of 14 pulsars. After passing Neptune's orbit in 1983, it became the first craft to head for interstellar space. But navigators noticed a mysterious, tiny drag on its signal called the Pioneer Anomaly.
